Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior, including a before/after example when useful.

- Owners changed: core/SDK, named plugins, launcher, or documentation/tooling.
- Validation: relevant checks and observed results; identify anything still unverified.
- User-visible changes: synthetic preview or affected-flow evidence, including saved results and UI acceptance criteria when applicable.
- Versions and changelogs: affected owner(s), or why no bump is needed. Obtain this draft PR's URL before finalizing new changelog entries; link the actual originating PR(s).
- Delivery: state completed stages and requested next steps. Merge/deployment follows explicit authorization for this PR; tags/releases need an explicit release request.

Keep private records, credentials, identifiers and runtime logs out of PR evidence. Follow [CONTRIBUTING](../whab/app/CONTRIBUTING.md).
